title: Round-trip raw Kanbus snapshots without changing identity or history
description:
As an operator, I want portable complete snapshots so I can change storage without rewriting my records.

Feature: Lossless Kanbus snapshots
  Scenario: Round-trip canonical data
    Given issues with unknown nested fields, null and missing values, stable IDs, links, comments, timestamps, large history and configuration
    When a consistent filesystem snapshot is copied to the canonical S3 prefix and its catalog rebuilt
    And that prefix is copied to a fresh filesystem project
    Then hashes match the original canonical bytes and normal Kanbus file paths
    And no canonical payload envelope or alternate object layout must be decoded
    And IDs, relations, comment order, history and configuration are preserved
    And no synthetic mutation events or timestamps are introduced
  Scenario: Idempotent duplicate
    Given a scoped record already imported with the same identity and bytes
    When the same snapshot is imported again
    Then it is a no-op without duplicate history
  Scenario: Conflicting duplicate
    Given two different payloads for the same scoped identity
    When a snapshot import is requested
    Then a conflict is reported before publishing partial replacement state
    And titles or contact addresses are not used to merge different IDs
  Scenario: Incomplete or corrupt snapshot
    Given a missing object or mismatched content hash
    When the snapshot is validated
    Then publication is rejected and the previous complete state remains usable
